author: cellish
body:
Hi there! 

As many of you know the new Atlas update release thingy was recently released (about 2 days ago from now)

Anyways, some things were really struggling like lag and stuff, but of of that stuff is fixed...
But, the notification sounds for monuments are really bad, before it was like BOOAAAANAAAAAAM and now it's like a firework sound, (1 firework) and thats not enough, like you could at least have something that pops up on the screen, for example the things that pop up when a team wins...

And the notification sound by getting a mon, should be for kills instead, and then ofc another sound for breaking a mon...

and btw, where did the badge colors go!??!

NEW THING!

Maybe not new, but at least to add more out off...

More badges should maybe be added because its quite boring for the ones that already have like every single badge, or like the most expensive one, maybe u dont have to add badges that are more expensive, but at least some new cool badges would be great from my opinion :)
